method: In each app's own DOM, found the title element's bottom rect and the description placeholder's top rect, computed a real mouse click at the horizontal midpoint of the title and the vertical midpoint of the gap between them, and dispatched a genuine page.mouse.click (not a focus-first synthetic click) at that point.

verdict.note: A real mouse click at the DOM-identified gap between the Task name and Description editors focuses the dialog itself (role=dialog, data-testid=task-details-modal) in BOTH apps now. Flow 4/5 previously found meologue focusing the Task name editor at this location; that is fixed. The only difference is meologue's dialog has no aria-label where Todoist's carries the task title as aria-label -- not part of this row's ask (focus target identity), noted for completeness.
